findings.title: Workflow selectors not gated on core availability
findings.problem: Spec AC6 requires selectors on visible pages to issue no assistants/workflows request when core is off. Only useResourceOptions and useGuardrailAssignmentOptions were gated; WorkflowSelector as used by GuardrailAssignmentEntitySelector and AwsAgentCoreRuntimeDetails is untouched.
findings.impact: In standalone mode these selectors may request workflows and show an error toast, violating AC6. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Trace each remaining selector that loads assistants/workflows; skip the request and return an empty list when !isCoreAvailable(appInfoStore.configs).
findings.check_notes: WorkflowSelector.tsx now short-circuits to an empty list when core is unavailable; AssistantSelector in the same popup not re-read.

fix.change: WorkflowSelector skips fetch and clears options when core is unavailable

findings.title: Analytics requests not audited for core-off toasts

findings.impact: Landing on Analytics in standalone mode (now the default landing page) may show error toasts from core-dependent tab requests. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Audit each Analytics tab and dashboard request; add skipErrorHandling or an empty state for any that depend on core.
findings.check_notes: src/store/analytics.ts untouched; mapped evidence is a no-code-change decision, not source proof for a code finding.
